gap.title: A 32 by 32 graph of the candidate family (k = 5): some AND/OR/NOT circuit of fan-in at most two with at most 170 gates represents it
gap.statement: ∃ C : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Circuit, PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.FanInTwo C ∧ C.size ≤ 170 ∧ PEqualNP.Represents.Represents (fun u v : Fin 32 => (([0xf2bc7573, 0x59092a9d, 0xc443c8c2, 0x1d58483a, 0x1b7982bb, 0xa8882290, 0x74d0fd25, 0x00041402, 0x6879a8a5, 0xd65a6f1a, 0x7455fba3, 0x24508c1a, 0x3050a010, 0x68658ad5, 0x10a00735, 0x5e55690e, 0x6ab804a4, 0x00b01458, 0xf447af40, 0x00b07351, 0xa88c2290, 0x40d9d7bc, 0x40241486, 0x54058082, 0x6891afb9, 0x50ddf79e, 0x553080be, 0x28c180f8, 0x6ac8ae9e, 0xa6860e80, 0x20508c18, 0x10f01050] : List ℕ).getD u.val 0).testBit v.val) C
gap.unlocks: A checked circuit supplies its NOT structure and a tighter gate budget to the graph comparison. A checked empty-range certificate covers its own range only.
gap.context: The 180-gate construction provides a starting point. The earlier five random restarts found no witness in three hours. These disjoint signatures refer to the same labeled 32 by 32 graph and cover every gate list.

gap.sketch: Encode all 1,024 one-row, one-column inputs. In gate-list order locate the first NOT whose first operand names an earlier gate (wire 64+j at a gate i with j<i). Read its output on the six pairs (k,k), k=0,...,5, as bits k of the hexadecimal shard mask. Missing, forward and raw-input operands do not qualify. Route 64 has no qualifying NOT. Match the full graph with at most 170 gates. Submit a replayable gate list. A timeout leaves the range open. An empty-range claim needs a checked range-specific proof.

rule: Never change a file that is already on main. Every proof is a NEW file; a recorded proof is final.
capacity_note: You hold 1 of 7 steps. 7 grows as your proofs are checked.
